name: TradeCore ERP
description: v1.0.9 build 2026-09-08-24 MULTI-DEVICE SCOPE & CRUD ALIGNMENT (MYSQL DIRECT WRITES + SWITCH-ONLY-ON-CLICK + ARRAY-INDEX CRASH GUARDS): (1) Req 3 — EXPLICIT-SWITCH-ONLY company binding: the background role-scope sync effect no longer force-rebinds an already-bound valid company each time a snapshot/flush refreshes the collections; the auto-switchCompany loop that broke scope alignment (top bar 'MAJENGO SHOPS' vs empty Store Management table) is gone — a company change now ONLY happens on an explicit UI dropdown/context click. (2) Req 4 — Store Management scope alignment: table now resolves the active company with the top bar the same way (String(localStorage active_company_id) first, then user.company_id/companyId, then currentCompanyId) and matches every store via its own companyId (or via its branch's) with loose string equality — the table can no longer render empty while the header shows the active store. (3) Req 5 — defensive array-index guards: RootTraReportsPanel company filter no longer crashes with 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 1)' on null hole rows and its id-vs-name comparison mismatch (filter always emptied the table) is fixed, plus null-row guards added to store/branch scope filters. (4) Req 1+2 verified present (builds 12/19/20/21): Add/Edit/Delete Store, Branch, Category, User commit direct to MySQL via v2_upsert_store/branch/category/user_account endpoints (diffed delta, no blob only), and snapshots are assembled live from the stores/branches/categories/user_accounts tables so Device B sees Device A's writes on refresh with no browser-storage dependency.
